description: Order a VPS and pay from the account credit balance — the balance must already cover the price (top up first with impreza_topup). For the VPS, choose location, os, cpu_cores, memory_gb and disk_gb from impreza_vps_offer and leave product_id out; the price is exactly what impreza_vps_offer quotes for that configuration. For a fixed plan such as Tor Hosting, pass its product_id from impreza_list_products instead (and config_options only if that plan has some). Ordered here, a VPS (the configurable VPS or a fixed VPS plan) defaults to app=@agent: it is born with the Impreza agent so it can receive app deployments, and the result shows it as app_requested. Pass app=none for a bare OS (the customer portal and cart keep a bare OS as their default); a bare VPS can get the agent later through impreza_install_agent with customer confirmation. Installing the agent does not connect an MCP client or create a credential. An accepted order is not a ready agent: the service appears under impreza_list_services first, and the agent appears in impreza_list_servers only once it has installed and connected. Requires the "manage" scope. Returns order_id, invoice_id, amount, the configuration and status. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.

app.description: Optional initial software, as text. Omitted, null or blank: '@agent' (the Impreza agent), for the configurable VPS and for fixed VPS plans alike. 'none' for a bare OS, '@agent-mcp' (agent plus MCP), a @panel-* control panel, or a catalog app name from impreza_list_apps. Plans that are not a VPS ignore it.

billing_cycle.description: One of: monthly, quarterly, semiannually, annually, biennially, triennially.

config_options.description: Fixed plans only: optionId-to-value map from that plan's product details. Every option must belong to the selected plan.

cpu_cores.description: VPS vCPU count, inside the range impreza_vps_offer lists.

disk_gb.description: VPS SSD disk in GB, inside the range impreza_vps_offer lists.

domain.description: Fixed plans only: domain for the order line.

hostname.description: Optional server hostname (a DNS name such as "web-1"). Two identical VPS orders within a day are refused as a repeat unless their hostnames differ.

location.description: VPS location: an id, slug or name from impreza_vps_offer, e.g. "romania".

memory_gb.description: VPS memory in GB, inside the range impreza_vps_offer lists.

os.description: VPS operating system: an id, slug or name from impreza_vps_offer, e.g. "ubuntu-24.04".

product_id.description: Only for a fixed plan (e.g. Tor Hosting) from impreza_list_products. Leave it out for the VPS.

name: impreza_order_vps
title: Order a VPS
